notes.title: Fixed Major Bug & Update
notes.notes:
Summary of bug fix:
- Fixed Major Bug when starting a new game and beating the first level.

Update on Development:
Hey all! It's been about  10 months since I've worked on the game.
I needed to take a break and focus on other things I wanted to accomplish.

I attempted to play the game last night and was in horror to see that 
there was a game crashing bug after level 1 ! 
I hope this new update fixes it. 

I'm working on a NEW special game (anouncement coming soon!) 

I'm still planning to continue updating Fallen's Challenge with more levels and Boss fights,
at the same time so - stay tuned!

Thank you for the support. 
This is just the beginning.
